name: Bank statement
prompt:
A Bank Statement is an official bank-issued periodic statement for a personal or business deposit account that typically includes:
- Bank name/branding
- Account holder name
- Account number (full or masked)
- Statement period start and end dates
- Beginning and ending balances
- A transaction ledger (date, description, amount; sometimes running balance)
- Optional summary totals (total deposits/withdrawals)

VARIABILITY:
- Layout, pagination, terminology vary by bank and by statement type.

EXCLUSIONS (NOT this class):
- Individual transaction receipts
- Pay stubs or income statements
- Credit reports
- Loan agreements / promissory notes
- Screenshots of online banking dashboards
- Aggregated financial reports
